mapper.sql: select shop_code, partnercode, partnername, partnertype, address, contactperson, mobile, telephone, activeflag, remark, createuser, createtime, updateuser, updatetime from sdsshop.u_m_partner
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_partner( shop_code, partnercode, partnername, partnertype, address, contactperson, mobile, telephone, activeflag, remark, createuser, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{partnerCode}, #{partnerName}, #{partnerType}, #{address}, #{contactPerson}, #{mobile}, #{telephone}, #{activeFlag}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_partner set partnername = #{partnerName}, partnertype = #{partnerType}, address = #{address}, contactperson = #{contactPerson}, mobile = #{mobile}, telephone = #{telephone}, activeflag = #{activeFlag}, remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and partnercode = #{partnerCode}
